1306-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Mana Crypt, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

549-4247-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-4247-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-4247-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

728-2577-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
728-2577-6763-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-2366-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Conspiracy.
728-2366-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-728-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

301-4738-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
301-4738-7096.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

3819-5671-7808.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Heart of Yavimaya from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Heart of Yavimaya into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Heart of Yavimaya from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Heart of Yavimaya from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Heart of Yavimaya into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
3819-5671-7808.notes: You can return other lands with their dredge abilities instead, as you're able to do so.

670-1619-2665-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-1376-4785.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-4785.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4613-4968-7691.description:
Activate The Thing by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Thing triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2523-2869-6826.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2523-2869-6826.description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Masked Meower that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability.
Repeat using the Masked Meower token

2724-4006-4013.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Eldrazi Displacer. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
4050-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

413-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
413-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-6887-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

997-4446-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
997-4446-5170-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1062-3484-4298-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3484-4298-5674.description:
Activate Borborygmos Enraged by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Borborygmos Enraged ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2060-2919-4222-4597.description:
Activate Shu Farmer by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Shu Farmer.
Repeat.

589-1786-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-1786-4017.description:
Gain life.
Fathom Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent loses 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4484-4871-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
413-4484-4871-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
413-4484-4871-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-4484-4871-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

856-2438-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2438-4321-5631.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

488-1482-4211-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-4211-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

440-1339-5231-5796.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-5231-5796.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Starving Revenant trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Starving Revenant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

428-1817-3769-5096.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
428-1817-3769-5096.description:
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Ghyrson Starn spell.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 9.

204-1858-2056-2633-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-4359.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

2023-2557-4050-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Aragorn's first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Human Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1308-4659-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
1308-4659-5320.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
1308-4659-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

1170-4761-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.
